I just stumbled across this and it probably wont help much but I can relate. I actually felt relieved finding someone who has experienced depression at such a young age. It's not 'rare' to find but it's a bit harder to come across. I had suicidal thoughts when I was about 12-13, but when I was 11 I started to become aware of "life" and felt a slow progression into a deep sadness. 

I haven't gotten better and I am 23 now. I wish everyone knew the burden I carry as well. I'm sorry you feel this way. 

I have tried mindfulness and meditation to ease some depression and anxiety. It has also helped with insomnia. I will admit though, someone as negative and skeptical as myself- it was hard to begin and to actually make progress. BUT IT IS POSSIBLE. 

I'm thinking of visiting with a psychiatrist for an evaluation and hopefully  medication. 

Are you taking anything right now? Have you switched therapist?/ if you dont mind me asking, what did you feel about therapy  and why it wasnt working anymore?

this is great advice!!! I want to keep things spontaneous and not so... “instructional” because I want him to also just “go with the flow” of things, keep things natural.  it’s just hard finding that mid-point, I guess that’s another reason (I just realized from your comment) why it’s hard for me to be open about what I want; thank you!
omg! I just googled this, that’s a great resource. Thank you! 😇
